assignmentHtml.task:
全面调查 Zee TV 的 YouTube 频道。查明以下事项：

  1. 稳定频道 ID 及规范 URL。
  2. 运营方：Zee Entertainment Enterprises / Essel Group。企业隶属关系链，以及任何所有权变化（例如 Sony 收购 Zee 5／Zee 合并谈判）。
  3. 频道创建日期，以及目前仍公开的最早上传视频。
  4. 运营地点及频道显示的国家。
  5. 使用的语言。
  6. 主要内容类别（印度电视连续剧）。
  7. 内容供应模式：广播电视机构的节目存档。
  8. 代表性系列。提供直接来源 URL。
assignmentHtml.context: 根据 Communitrics 于 2026 年 9 月 2 日的快照，Zee TV 排名第 11 名，历史累计观看量约为 118B（1180 亿）次。需要可核实的事实，并附来源链接。
assignmentHtml.expected_output: 一份关于 Zee TV 的结构化资料，包含全部要求的字段，每个字段均附来源 URL。

answerHtml:
ZEE TV YOUTUBE CHANNEL DOSSIER

1. Stable Channel ID & Canonical URL

  • Channel ID: UCppHT7SZKKvar4Oc9J4oljQ
  • Canonical URL: https://www.youtube.com/@zeetv (also accessible as https://www.youtube.com/user/zeetv)
  • Sources: Wikipedia List of Most-Viewed YouTube Channels; Social Blade; YouTube about page snippet showing '98.9M subscribers · 219,120 videos · 118,603,240,365 views'

2. Operator & Corporate Chain

  • Operated by: Zee Entertainment Enterprises Limited (ZEEL), subsidiary of Essel Group
  • Founder: Subhash Chandra (Chairman); CEO: Punit Goenka
  • Headquartered in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
  • Ownership changes:
    • Essel Group historically held majority stake; reports indicate Essel Group's stake reduced to ~3.99% minority by 2021–2024
    • September 2021: Announced ~$10B merger with Sony Pictures Networks India (Sony to hold ~51%); NCLT approved August 2023
    • January 22, 2024: Sony terminated the merger citing unmet closing conditions
    • ZEE5 (streaming platform) remains wholly owned by ZEEL — no Sony acquisition occurred
  • Sources: Wikipedia Zee Entertainment Enterprises; WSJ; Reuters

3. Channel Creation Date & Earliest Upload

  • Created: December 10, 2005 (YouTube's own 'About' page states 'Joined Dec 10, 2005'); Social Blade records December 11, 2005 (timezone difference)
  • Earliest still-public upload: Not precisely determinable. The channel has been active since at least 2006 ('1 year on YouTube' milestone unlocked 2006 per Social Blade). Some uploads from 2012 remain (e.g., Hum Paanch Ep. 33 uploaded Aug 22, 2012). However, the channel was hacked on November 22, 2024 and reinstated November 25, 2024, which may have removed older content. Without direct YouTube date-filtered search access, the earliest surviving upload cannot be confirmed.

4. Operating Location & Displayed Country

  • Country: India (explicitly listed in YouTube metadata and Wikipedia)
  • Operating base: Mumbai, India
  • Sources: YouTube @zeetv/about page; Wikipedia List of Most-Viewed YouTube Channels; Kaggle top-100 YouTube channels dataset

5. Languages

  • Primary language: Hindi
  • Related Zee channels cover regional languages (Telugu, Tamil, Kannada, Marathi, Bangla, etc.) under the same corporate umbrella
  • Source: Wikipedia Zee TV; YouTube channel description

6. Primary Content Category

  • Entertainment (Indian TV serials/general entertainment)
  • Source: Wikipedia List of Most-Viewed YouTube Channels; Kaggle dataset

7. Content Supply Model

  • Broadcaster archives: Zee TV uploads full episodes, webisodes, best-of clips, and promos directly from its television production library. It is one of few Indian GECs that has uploaded almost all of its serial catalogue since YouTube inception. Content spans current and historical Zee TV shows.
  • Sources: Wikipedia List of programmes broadcast by Zee TV; Reddit r/IndianTellyTalk discussion; Indiawest

8. Representative Series

  • Currently airing: Vasudha (2024), Ganga Mai Ki Betiyan (2025), Jagadhatri (2025), Lakshmi Niwas (2026), Tu Hi Re Dil Mein (2026), Dilon Ki Ram Leela (2026), Tumm Se Tumm Tak (2025)
  • Iconic former: Hum Paanch (1995–2005), Pavitra Rishta (2009–2014), Qubool Hai (2012–2016), Jodha Akbar (2013–2015), Kumkum Bhagya (2014–2025), Saat Phere (2008), Sa Re Ga Ma Pa (1995–present), Dance India Dance (2009–present)
  • Source: Wikipedia List of programmes broadcast by Zee TV

9. Key Statistics (as of September 2026)

  • ~99 million subscribers (98.9M per Social Blade)
  • ~120 billion lifetime views (118.6B per YouTube about page; ~119.9B per Social Blade Sept 2026)
  • ~220,000 videos
  • Rank #11 among most-viewed YouTube channels globally (per Wikipedia, ~117B views as of June 2026; Communitrics snapshot Sept 2, 2026 reported ~118B)
  • Sources: Social Blade; Wikipedia List of Most-Viewed YouTube Channels; YouTube about page

10. Notable Events

  • November 22, 2024: Channel terminated due to hacking; reinstated November 25, 2024
  • May 17, 2025: Zee TV rebranded to 'Z TV' with new logo
  • Source: Wikitubia/Fandom; Wikipedia Zee TV

evidence.snippet: Official account of India's pioneering Hindi General Entertainment Channel of India. Joined Dec 10, 2005. 98.9M subscribers. 219,120 videos. 118,603,240,365 views.
evidence.supports: Channel ID (UCppHT7SZKKvar4Oc9J4oljQ), canonical URL, creation date, subscriber count, view count, primary language Hindi

evidence.snippet: Zee Entertainment Enterprises Limited (ZEEL) (formerly Zee Telefilms) is an Indian media conglomerate. Headquartered in Mumbai... Parent: Essel Group... On 22 January 2024, Sony Pictures Networks India issued a notice to Zee Entertainment Enterprises effectively terminating the merger proceedings... In 2024, Zee Entertainment Enterprises partnered with Sony Pictures Entertainment.
evidence.supports: Operator identity, corporate chain (Essel Group → ZEEL), Sony merger termination Jan 22, 2024, headquarters Mumbai

evidence.snippet: Created On: December 11, 2005. subscribers: 99M. views: 120B. videos: 220K. Longevity: 1 year on YouTube - Unlocked 2006. 20 years on YouTube - Unlocked 2025.
evidence.supports: Channel creation date, activity since 2006, view/subscriber/video counts as of Sept 2026

evidence.snippet: Rank 11 | Zee TV | Zee Entertainment Enterprises | 117 billion views | Entertainment | India | Hindi.
evidence.supports: Global rank #11, content category (Entertainment), country (India), primary language (Hindi), network affiliation

evidence.snippet: On November 22, 2024, Zee TV was terminated off of YouTube due to the channel being hacked. The channel was reinstated on November 25th. Zee TV has rebranded to 'Z TV' on May 17, 2025.
evidence.supports: Hacking incident Nov 22, 2024; reinstatement Nov 25; rebrand to Z TV May 17, 2025

evidence.snippet: Currently broadcast: Vasudha (16 Sep 2024), Tumm Se Tumm Tak (7 Jul 2025), Ganga Mai Ki Betiyan (22 Sep 2025), Jagadhatri (10 Nov 2025), Lakshmi Niwas (12 Jan 2026), Tu Hi Re Dil Mein (15 Jun 2026), Dilon Ki Ram Leela (24 Aug 2026). Formerly: Hum Paanch (1995–2005), Kumkum Bhagya (2014–2025), Pavitra Rishta (2009–2014), Qubool Hai (2012–2016), Jodha Akbar (2013–2015), Sa Re Ga Ma Pa (1995–present), Dance India Dance (2009–present), Khana Khazana (1993–2012).
evidence.supports: Representative current and former series providing content supply model evidence (broadcaster archives)

evidence.snippet: ZEE5 or Z5 is an Indian subscription video on-demand over-the-top streaming television service owned by Zee Entertainment Enterprises.
evidence.supports: ZEE5 remains owned by ZEEL; no Sony acquisition of ZEE5 occurred

evidence.snippet: MrBeast's entry pushes Zee TV off the top ten [of top 10]. Previously ranked within top 10 with ~118B+ views.
evidence.supports: Zee TV's position near top 10 with ~118B views, consistent with Communitrics Sept 2, 2026 snapshot

evidence.snippet: Asia TV USA Ltd. and YouTube TV have announced the successful integration of 18 Zee Entertainment channels into the American market... Zee TV, the flagship Hindi general entertainment channel... Zee's Chief Business Officer for International Business, Ashok Namboodiri.
evidence.supports: Content distribution model through broadcaster partnerships; Zee TV as flagship Hindi GEC
